deliverables: Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, wallet data export, and governance tooling enhancements
request.what: 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements including frontend/backend development, infrastructure, support, audits/oversight, and day-to-day operations

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual operating costs for 12 months.
The budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to admin, and 2% to audits.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96/year for Personal and $360/year for Company users, and says roughly 5,500 paying users would cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl states it has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
The proposer commits to converting up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins in a public company wallet, returning any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposer commits to independent audits in February 2027 and August 2027 covering receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

The proposer commits to semiannual repayment assessments and to using surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid-plan income above $420,000 to repay the treasury until $420,000 in Ada value has been repaid.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposal states the main UI will not be open-source, while some libraries used in Eternl will be published via the npm registry.

summary: The proposal seeks ₳2,350,000 for one year of Eternl operations and sustainability transition, with stated oversight, repayment, and paid-plan mechanisms but several key adoption and cost assumptions asserted without evidence in the anchor text.
